newsitem.title: UK: First stage of Naples airport expansion completed.
newsitem.headline: First stage of Naples airport expansion completed.

text.p: The first stage of a three-year restructuring has been completed at Naples airport with the conversion of former Alenia hangers and the building of six new aprons, the airport management company (GESAC) said.
This should give the airport an adequate basis for future development, said GESAC president Ludovico Barone. Cargo handling facilities have been installed in the former hangers.
A budget of 7.1 billion lire ($4.2 million) has been forecast for a new cargo building with an interchangeable direct access for trucks and aircraft which will increase the cargo area ten-fold.
By March 1988 the surface area of the new cargo site should have increased to 6,000 sq m from 1,000 sq m with an apron size of 15,000 sq m.
The total budget, including a shopping centre on the first floor of the terminal building, has been forecast at 40 billion lire over three years.
During May 1997 flown cargo traffic of 385.2 tonnes was 9.3 percent up on May last year whilst mail rose 41.3 percent to 162.2 tonnes.
British airports operator BAA is due to take a 70 per cent stake in Naples airport this summerof its capital share to BAA this summer. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
